resources.string: Intelligent Mobile Application for Predictive Network Switching
Mobile Computing Capstone • Real-Time Telemetry & App-Level Switching
Persistent status updates while NetSwitch AI monitors live Wi-Fi and cellular telemetry.
Notifications when predictive degradation or automatic app-level switching occurs.

Android restricts third-party apps from modifying system-wide global network settings or toggling mobile data. NetSwitch AI uses ConnectivityManager.requestNetwork() and bindProcessToNetwork() to route this app\'s traffic over the optimal available interface.
